work.summary: Closed the bounded FINAL.20 HF2B follow-up and replaced paid TinyFish dependence for deterministic browser regression with a reusable GitHub Actions + Playwright/Chromium workflow. Explicit report confirmation now synchronizes confirmed product rows into Product Master in the same session before the confirmation promise settles, while draft reports remain excluded and inventory quantities remain untouched. The first GitHub Actions run exposed a real startup race in confirm-hook installation; the hook was made synchronous when Analytics is already available, then all six browser gates passed. PR #124 merged, matching Vercel production is READY, and the browser workflow passed again on the main push.
implemented: Wrapped the existing explicit reports.confirm path so a successful confirmation is followed by confirmed-report product synchronization before the confirmation promise resolves.
Product synchronization failure is non-fatal after report confirmation and cannot roll back or misreport an already-confirmed report.
Draft/unconfirmed reports remain excluded from product-master synchronization.
Fixed a startup race found by the new CI: confirm/sort wrappers install synchronously when Analytics data APIs are already present, otherwise they wait for Analytics readiness.
Kept Product Intelligence classification proposals review-only; no inferred classification is automatically confirmed.
Added tests/run-browser-gates.mjs using headless Playwright Chromium with fresh browser contexts for six deterministic browser gates.
Added .github/workflows/browser-regression-gates.yml for relevant pull requests, main pushes, and manual dispatch using a local static server.

Browser CI covers product-master same-session sync/search/order/inventory safety plus compact sold-out visit context, OCR continuation vendor safety, OCR field correction, visit closeout/overlap, and machine bring opt-in gates.
Updated workflow hygiene documentation: GitHub Actions + Playwright is the standard no-TinyFish path for deterministic browser regression pages.
Verified matching Vercel production deployment dpl_C85doLkdPWMRhmNTg73WpxvvVFbx is READY.
Verified PR browser workflow run 35360428514 PASS after the startup-race fix.
Verified main-push Browser regression gates run 35360634326 completed successfully for merge commit 3330d77d2266b9d3737cd14a9eab44ab382d21a1.
GitHub Pages deployment for the same main commit also completed successfully.
No DB/schema migration, automatic report confirmation, inventory movement semantics change, Analytics engine change, or learned numeric forecasting change was introduced.
